findings.oracle: Rewritten as test_cached_success_stored_in_dict_matches_real_probe: no AsyncMock; drives the real SandboxManager._probe_type (live where/CIM + qemu-system discovery) through get_available_types(); independent oracle is a fresh WindowsSandbox/QEMUSandbox is_available(); asserts every probed type is present in availability_cache and entry.available is exactly the oracle bool.

Rewritten as test_probe_called_once_per_available_type_across_five_calls: no patch/fake; _RecordingManager delegates to the real super()._probe_type and counts live probes; asserts each type is probed exactly once across five get_available_types() calls (verified RED at count 5 when cache write is removed) and each returned list equals the independent real-oracle availability.

Rewritten as test_successful_result_returned_consistently: no patch.object/fake_probe; three real get_available_types() calls via the live probe path; asserts the three lists are identical to each other and byte-for-byte equal to the independent oracle ([t for t in (windows,qemu) if WindowsSandbox/QEMUSandbox.is_available()]).
